asked.item: Did uploading own photos use credits?
Did writing own caption (no AI) use credits?

verdict.reason: The pages state that uploading your own images and drafting text do not use credits, and where to check the balance.

steps.text: No, uploading your own image and drafting text do not use credits.
Credits are only used for generating AI images and AI videos.
You can check your balance by opening Settings > Billing and reading AI Credits and Usage.
